rule.statement: The conditions to be proved according to Section 4 of the Prescription Ordinance to claim 'to be restored into possession' of the allotments of land have not been proven by the Plaintiff.
rule.supporting_quote: I hold that the conditions to be proved according to Section 4 of the Prescription Ordinance to claim 'to be restored into possession' of the allotments of land as mentioned in the Schedules to the Plaint have not been proven by the Plaintiff.
